title: Oscar Acceptance Became Provenance-Bound and Run-Bound
summary: Oscar acceptance is now bound to the exact claim, exact evidence set, exact commit, exact checked-out Oscar implementation, execution provenance, result integrity digest, and—inside GitHub Actions—the active workflow run.
what_happened: The first provenance-hardening implementation passed fresh CI on PR #42 and produced an ACCEPT artifact with deterministic claim/evidence fingerprints, implementation provenance, execution provenance, and a result digest. A second adversarial pass exposed that promotion could still accept a copied artifact from another CI run. That boundary was repaired by requiring the Oscar execution run ID to match the active GitHub Actions run. The first PR #43 fixture failed because valid unit-test fixtures used a fixed run ID while CI supplied a real run ID; the fixture was corrected to inherit the active run ID, then fresh CI passed all 21 promotion tests and 18 Oscar tests.
what_we_learned: A digest is integrity evidence, not an unforgeable signature; provenance must also bind inputs, implementation, commit, and execution context.
Copied Oscar ACCEPT artifacts must not be reusable in a different CI run.
Promotion should validate Oscar provenance independently rather than trusting fields merely because they exist in an artifact.
Adversarial tests must run in the same CI environment they govern; fixture assumptions can create false failures.
The existing Claim → Evidence → Builder Verification → Oscar → Promotion authority chain remains sufficient; no second authority system is needed.
why_it_matters: This closes the most important remaining artifact-forgery path in the Oscar promotion boundary and makes independent acceptance materially more trustworthy.
what_changed: Added deterministic claim SHA-256 and evidence-set SHA-256 fingerprints to Oscar results.
Added exact Oscar implementation blob SHA and implementation commit provenance.
Added GitHub Actions execution source and run ID provenance.
Added a complete Oscar result SHA-256 integrity digest.
Made promotion independently recompute and validate Oscar provenance.
Made promotion reject Oscar artifacts produced by a different active CI run.
Added adversarial tests for tampered result, claim, evidence, implementation, execution provenance, and wrong CI run.
next_best_action: Obtain and inspect a fresh push-triggered CI run for the exact canonical main merge commit before labeling that merge commit VERIFIED_CI.
